related.title: AWS CloudTrail：Digest鏈範圍與缺口聲明
related.titleEn: AWS CloudTrail: digest-chain scope and explicit gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三類死信索引、修復差異、重送批號、讀回證據及未解決清單，保留原始檔唯讀副本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver classified indexes, repair diffs, replay batch IDs, read-back evidence and unresolved records, retaining read-only originals.
related.difference: 建立小時、digest、前一摘要鏈接及log檔對照，區分未驗證、驗證失敗與根本未收錄。
related.differenceEn: Map hours, digests, predecessor links and log files, distinguishing unvalidated, failed and never-covered intervals.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 回收率以進入死信的唯一事件為分母；成功重送次數不能取代唯一成功事件數。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100筆死信中，60筆可修格式、25筆暫時錯誤、15筆無法解碼；第一次成功回收其中50、20、0筆。 唯一回收70筆，回收率70%；剩30筆須維持原因與負責人，不能靜默刪除。
本課計算的是時間窗口覆蓋，不是密碼安全機率；自編雜湊鏈不能冒充AWS簽章驗證。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 24個預期小時，各有一個教學摘要槽位；其中2小時未啟用收錄，另1個摘要缺失，其餘21個可核對。 可核對時間覆蓋21/24=87.5%；未啟用與遺失共3小時應各自列出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Recovery rate uses unique dead-letter events as denominator; successful retry attempts cannot replace unique recovered records. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of one hundred dead-letter records, sixty have repairable schema errors, twenty-five transient faults and fifteen undecodable payloads; recovery succeeds for 50,20,0. Seventy unique events recover, giving 70%; thirty retain unresolved reasons and owners rather than disappearing silently.

Measure time-window coverage rather than cryptographic security probability; a teaching hash chain is not AWS signature validation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twenty-four expected hourly slots include two disabled intervals and one missing digest; twenty-one remain locally checkable. Checkable temporal coverage is 21/24=87.5%; list the three uncovered hours by distinct cause.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MITRE ATT&CK：資料先決條件與可驗證覆蓋
related.titleEn: MITRE ATT&CK: data prerequisites and verifiable coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三類死信索引、修復差異、重送批號、讀回證據及未解決清單，保留原始檔唯讀副本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver classified indexes, repair diffs, replay batch IDs, read-back evidence and unresolved records, retaining read-only originals.
related.difference: 建立選定行為、所需資料、可用感測器、驗證樣本與結果五欄矩陣，區分規則存在與證據成立。
related.differenceEn: Map selected behaviors to required data, available sensors, test fixtures and outcomes, distinguishing rule existence from verified evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 回收率以進入死信的唯一事件為分母；成功重送次數不能取代唯一成功事件數。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100筆死信中，60筆可修格式、25筆暫時錯誤、15筆無法解碼；第一次成功回收其中50、20、0筆。 唯一回收70筆，回收率70%；剩30筆須維持原因與負責人，不能靜默刪除。
可驗證覆蓋須滿足資料可用及測試成功兩條件；未測、不可測與測試失敗應分開。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 選20項教學行為，16項有對應規則，12項資料先決條件滿足，當中9項通過合成驗證。 已驗證覆蓋9/20=45%；16/20=80%只描述規則標籤存在，不是相同量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Recovery rate uses unique dead-letter events as denominator; successful retry attempts cannot replace unique recovered records. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of one hundred dead-letter records, sixty have repairable schema errors, twenty-five transient faults and fifteen undecodable payloads; recovery succeeds for 50,20,0. Seventy unique events recover, giving 70%; thirty retain unresolved reasons and owners rather than disappearing silently.

Verifiable coverage requires both available data and passing tests; untested, untestable and failed cases remain distinct. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Select twenty teaching behaviors: sixteen have rules, twelve have required data, and nine of those pass synthetic validation. Verified coverage is 45%; the 80% rule-tag presence describes a different quantity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
